The first differences follow \(2,2,4,4,6,6,\ldots\), so the \(i\)-th difference is \(2\lceil i/2\rceil\). Thus
\[
a_n=\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}2\left\lceil \frac i2\right\rceil = \left\lfloor \frac{n^2}{2}\right\rfloor.
\]
For \(n=20\):
\[
a_{20}=\left\lfloor \frac{20^2}{2}\right\rfloor = 200.
\]
\[
\boxed{200}
\]
